items.when: A sub-question asks for the teams a player later played for after being drafted
items.action: Route to the KG as primary source; use table only as fallback if KG returns no answer.
items.lesson: The KG has player-team relations (e.g., member of sports team) that can list all teams; the competition table only covers specific games and may miss teams from other seasons.
items.evidence: Record 1133: sq2 routed to teamgame_basic but returned empty; fallback to KG succeeded with all four teams.

items.when: A sub-question asks for the teams a player later played for
items.action: Parse the relation as 'member of sports team' and the return type as 'team'.
items.lesson: The KG's member_of_sports_team relation directly lists all teams a player has been associated with, whereas the competition table only provides game-specific team assignments.
items.evidence: Record 1133: sq2 semantic parse used 'play for' but routed to table; KG fallback provided correct teams.
